summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 (event date September 22, 2026) disclosing that its Alignment Engine subsidiary entered a Master Services Agreement with an unnamed customer. Two initial orders cover phased dedicated AMD GPU clusters at an Ohio AI infrastructure campus: MI355X GPUs for 48 months starting December 31, 2026, and MI455X GPUs for 48 months starting June 30, 2027, aggregating roughly $1.17 billion of contractual value. Additional orders may be placed with written authorization; termination rights include a 30-day cure period and bankruptcy triggers. No security, price, premium, or ownership terms; a routine commercial contract, not a special situation.
